SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'BNKM' AND TABLE_NAME ='customeraccountstatus';

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[customeraccountstatus_WITH_DUP_20230504]
( 
	[RN] [bigint]  NULL,
	[CustomerAccountId] [nvarchar](32)  NOT NULL,
	[PeriodStartTimestamp] [datetime]  NOT NULL,
	[PeriodEndTimestamp] [datetime]  NULL,
	[CustomerAccountStatusTypeId] [nvarchar](32)  NULL,
	[CustomerAccountStatusNote] [nvarchar](1024)  NULL,
	[CustomerId] [nvarchar](64)  NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [nvarchar](32)  NULL,
	[SourceSystemCode] [varchar](50)  NOT NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NOT NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NOT NULL,
	[InsertDttm] [datetime]  NOT NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO


--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT  CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartTimestamp, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartTimestamp, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1
--
SELECT * FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartTimestamp, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY PeriodEndTimestamp DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO bnkm.customeraccountstatus_WITH_DUP_20230504  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus; --Target table to remove duplicate
--
SELECT * FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus_WITH_DUP_20230504 WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = '' ORDER BY RN

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus_WITH_DUP_20230504
8386616
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus
8386616

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.customeraccountstatus; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.customeraccountstatus --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,CustomerId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus_WITH_DUP_20230504 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;

--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT  CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartTimestamp, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.customeraccountstatus -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartTimestamp, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1
